window.name: July
window.rule: the 2028 calendar month with the least BASE direct-to-Earth visibility

with.label: Lunar ATC: robots auction pooled jobs over the mesh; road layer atc (shared reservations)

settings.scenario: p5 3eq, 30 % load, team share 0.10, landing closures, fixpoint

settings.scenario: p5 3eq, 30 % load, team share 0.10, landing closures, fixpoint

fields.frame: terrain/hero/sites.json: x, y in metres (integers), BASE at [7450, 7510]; site ids as there
fields.time: hours since 1 Jan 2028 00:00 UTC, rounded to 0.001 h
fields.fleet: [id, owner, class, antenna_m], in id order (the order of every per-vehicle array)
fields.sites: id -> [x_m, y_m]; pads at their stand-off point (where a rover works), as the road legs end there
fields.nodes: radio nodes that are not vehicles: id -> [x_m, y_m, antenna_m] ('BASE' = the 10 m mast)
fields.roads: {edges: edge id -> [[x_m, y_m], ...], res: edge id -> [resource id per point, -1 = two-lane], branched: resource id -> bool, bays: [[x_m, y_m], ...] (where a single-lane resource ends)}; edge ids are the road file's leg ids ('PAD_A@1->BASE'); no_road: edges the road file lacks (pad to pad), given as a straight line between the two sites (the engine drives them by its distance table, with no single-lane segments)
fields.legs: vehicle id -> [[t0, t1, from, to, kind, load_kg, job, edge], ...]; kind: drive, work, wait_segment (held before a single-lane segment), wait_apron (R10 slot), hand (conflict referred to Earth; for the vehicle that goes first, a stop at the segment entry given as an edge piece with f0 = f1), reposition; edge = [edge id, f0, f1, resource] for drive and reposition (positions at sample index f x (n - 1) of the edge's polyline, linear in time; drive legs are split at every reserved segment's entry and exit, resource = its id on the piece inside it, else -1), null otherwise (from == to: the vehicle is at that site); a vehicle with no leg at a time is idle at its last 'to'
fields.jobs: [id, t_start, t_end, vehicle ids, item ids, note, route]
fields.items: [id, owner, mass_kg, class, priority, origin, dest, t_ready, t_picked, t_delivered, carrier, team_size]
fields.closures: [t0, t1, pad, radius_km] landing keep-out windows
fields.crew: [t0, t1, site, zone_km, v_kmh] crew walks (R6)
fields.reservations: [resource, t_in, t_out, direction, owner, vehicle id]; resource 'apron:<pad>' for pad slots
fields.radio: first entry [t0, links, hops_to_base, base_up] (the full state at t0); later entries [t, links_added, links_removed, hops_to_base, base_up] at each decision epoch where anything changed; links [a, b] with vehicle ids and 'BASE'; hops_to_base an array in fleet order (-1 = cut off)
fields.decisions: [t, kind, detail]; with: award {vehicles, items, note}, conflict, wasted_trip, failed_meeting, team_no_agreement, parallel_winner, claim_won, claim_stale, dropped_job, status_lost (detail = count in that epoch), rally {site, vehicles, timeout_h}; without: assignment {owner, vehicles, items}, hand_referral {vehicle, wait_h, resource}
fields.msgs: [[t_hour, count], ...] radio transmissions per hour (with); empty when not modelled (without: Earth messages are not modelled)
fields.earth: [[t0, t1], ...] BASE direct-to-Earth windows: every window that overlaps the run window, unclipped, plus the first one after it
fields.summary: window totals the page recounts: urgent_items_waiting (priority-1 items ready in the window and not picked up within 24 h, or by t1), idle_robot_hours (fleet hours in the window outside every leg), messages_per_hour (sum of msgs / window hours), earth_hand_hours (hours of hand legs inside the window)
